offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests (base price, up to 10 results); each result above 10 adds $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果(含页面内容), 可选 highlights、结构化输出、AI summary
offerings.note: 实时搜索并附带 token 高效页面内容；搜索类型包括 fast(450ms)、auto(~1s)、deep(4-12s)；『$7 / 1k』即 $0.007 per call。

offerings.name: Deep Search (/search type=deep)
offerings.pricing: deep-lite $12 / 1k requests; deep $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning $15 / 1k requests (base, up to 10 results)
offerings.price_basis: Deep Search base (deep-lite/deep, up to 10 results)
offerings.output_type: 多步研究，结构化输出并带引用
offerings.note: deep-lite ~4s; deep 4-15s; deep-reasoning 12-40s；额外结果与 AI page summaries 与标准搜索同价。

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: LLM 对问题的回答，带引用

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /contents (每 content type 分别计费)
offerings.output_type: 已知 URL 的全页文本、highlights 和摘要
offerings.note: 一个页面的 text/highlights/summary 各视图分别计数计费。

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests (base, up to 10 results); each result above 10 $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.output_type: 定时搜索，发现网上新事件

offerings.name: Agent API
offerings.pricing: Fixed effort: minimal $0.012 / low $0.025 / medium $0.10 / high $0.50 / xhigh $1.00 per request; or usage-based: Agent Compute Units $0.10 / ACU, search tool calls $0.005 / search, email enrichment $0.02, phone enrichment $0.07
offerings.price_basis: Agent 按固定 effort 每次请求或按用量计费(ACU+工具调用)
offerings.output_type: 异步深度研究、列表构建与信息补全
offerings.note: auto 为默认计量模式，默认 $5 cap；beta max 同费率默认 $20 cap。Connect 数据源额外按 provider 费率计费。
